 Thai Nguyen launches its first electric bus route.
 On the morning of October 30th, the Netherlands Trade and Tourism Joint Stock Company held the inauguration ceremony for electric bus route number 01, connecting Tan Long and Da Phuc. This is the first electric bus route operating in Thai Nguyen province.
 VietnamPlus • 30/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 To commemorate the 195th anniversary of the founding of Thai Nguyen province and the Thai Nguyen International Tea Festival 2026, on the morning of October 30th, the Ha Lan Trade and Tourism Joint Stock Company inaugurated electric bus route No. 01, connecting Tan Long (Thai Nguyen) and Da Phuc (Hanoi).
 This is the first electric bus route operating in Thai Nguyen province, contributing to improving the quality of public passenger transport services and promoting the green transformation process in the province.
 The project to invest in vehicles and technical infrastructure to serve the operation of the Tan Long-Da Phuc electric bus route, implemented by Ha Lan Trade and Tourism Joint Stock Company, has a total investment of 60 billion VND, including the following main items: investment in 15 KIM LONG B40-EV electric buses, manufactured in 2026, 100% new; 5 charging stations with a capacity of 240 kW along with the technical infrastructure system serving the charging stations; a 22 kV power line and a transformer station with a capacity of 1,600 kVA...
 Mr. Nguyen Manh Ha, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Ha Lan Trade and Tourism Joint Stock Company, said that to improve the operational efficiency of the Tan Long-Da Phuc electric bus route No. 01, the company organizes the operation of the bus route safely, stably and in accordance with regulations, builds an image of civilized, friendly and convenient electric buses, enhances the sense of responsibility of the drivers and service staff, and takes the needs and satisfaction of the people as the overarching goal in its business operations. 
 The Netherlands Trade and Tourism Joint Stock Company has invested in 15 brand-new KIM LONG B40-EV electric buses, manufactured in 2026, to operate on route 01. (Photo: Vu Hoang Giang/TTXVN) You may also like The company is committed to complying with legal regulations, closely coordinating with departments, agencies, and localities in organizing its operations, and proactively researching opportunities to expand its public passenger transport network using green energy vehicles when all necessary conditions are met...
 To facilitate investment in the development of public passenger transport, on December 10, 2025, the People's Council of Thai Nguyen province issued Resolution No. 35/2025/NQ-HĐND stipulating support policies for public passenger transport by bus in the province, effective from January 1, 2026.
 The province provides interest rate subsidies for loans to investment projects in green energy buses at a rate of 6% per year; the maximum subsidy is 100% of the loan contract value but not exceeding 80% of the approved vehicle value; the maximum subsidy period is no more than 7 years.
 In addition, the Resolution also stipulates policies to exempt or reduce bus fares for certain groups of users, contributing to encouraging people to use public transportation, improving access to services and promoting the development of public passenger transport in the province. Thai Nguyen province also strives to achieve a rate of 40% or more of public transport vehicles using green energy by 2030... 
 Speaking at the opening ceremony, Mr. Nguyen Linh, Permanent Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Thai Nguyen province, emphasized that the launch of the electric bus route is a realization of the province's commitment to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, limiting noise pollution, and protecting the local air quality, marking the beginning of a journey to spread "Green Transportation."
 To ensure the efficient operation of the electric bus route, the Standing Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Thai Nguyen province requested that the electric bus route operator prioritize service quality and passenger safety, ensure accurate bus schedules, maintain clean and modern vehicles, strictly comply with legal regulations on transportation business, and ensure traffic safety.
 You may also like The Provincial Department of Construction continues to coordinate with relevant agencies and units to advise on policies for developing green transportation, and developing a safe, synchronized, and sustainable public passenger transport network...
 Thai Nguyen province currently has more than 1,700 public passenger transport vehicles, including over 170 buses, transporting more than 12,500 passengers per day; of which, bus route No. 01 Tan Long-Da Phuc alone has 13 buses using fossil fuels, transporting more than 1,600 passengers per day.
